title: Differin Gel vs Glenmark Adapalene Gel 0.1%

brand.product: Differin Acne Treatment Gel 0.1% Adapalene, 45 g pump

alternative.product: Glenmark Adapalene Gel 0.1% Acne Treatment, 45 g tube

summary: Both are OTC adapalene 0.1% gel, the same FDA-approved retinoid at the same strength, in the same 45 g size.
evidence: Differin's FDA OTC label (NDA 020380) lists adapalene 0.1% gel. Walmart lists Glenmark Therapeutics' product as Adapalene Gel USP 0.1%, 45 g. Glenmark is an established generic drug manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller.
differences: Differin comes in a pump and Glenmark in a tube. Differin's inactive ingredients include methylparaben, and Glenmark markets its gel as paraben-free, so the inactive ingredients differ. We could not see Glenmark's full inactive list.

aspects.brand: Differin gel (OTC label): methylparaben
aspects.alternative: Glenmark adapalene gel: phenoxyethanol, no parabens

aspects.brand: Carbomer, edetate disodium, poloxamer 182, propylene glycol, water, sodium hydroxide, HCl
aspects.alternative: Carbomer, edetate disodium, poloxamer 182, propylene glycol, water, sodium hydroxide

why: Both are OTC adapalene 0.1% gels in 45 g, the same retinoid at the same strength. The Glenmark gel is paraben-free while the Differin label lists methylparaben, and the other inactives on the two lists match, so ask a pharmacist if you are unsure which suits your skin.

title: Head & Shoulders Classic Clean vs Equate Everyday Clean Dandruff Shampoo

brand.product: Head & Shoulders Dandruff Shampoo, Classic Clean, 28.2 fl oz

alternative.product: Equate Everyday Clean Nourishing Dandruff Shampoo, 28.2 fl oz

summary: Both are 1% pyrithione zinc dandruff shampoos in the same 28.2 fl oz size, and Equate is labelled 'Compare to Head & Shoulders Active Ingredient'.
evidence: Head & Shoulders Classic Clean Drug Facts list pyrithione zinc 1%. The Walmart listing for Equate Everyday Clean Nourishing lists 'Pyrithione Zinc 1% w/w', and Equate's Everyday Clean label on file says 'Compare to Head & Shoulders'. The Equate label is distributed by Walmart and registered by Garcoa, Inc.
differences: Only the active ingredient matches. The bases differ: for example, Equate uses cocamide MEA and H&S uses cocamidopropyl betaine and zinc carbonate. Scent also differs. When checked, Walmart showed the Equate 28.2 oz as out of stock; the 23.7 oz size was listed at $4.64.

aspects.brand: H&S Classic Clean label: sodium benzoate (no isothiazolinones)
aspects.alternative: Equate: sodium benzoate, benzyl alcohol plus methylchloroisothiazolinone and methylisothiazolinone

aspects.brand: H&S: FD&C Blue 1 and D&C Red 33
aspects.alternative: Equate: FD&C Blue 1 and FD&C Red 4

aspects.brand: H&S: sodium lauryl + laureth sulfate, cocamidopropyl betaine, dimethicone, zinc carbonate
aspects.alternative: Equate: sodium laureth-3, lauryl and ammonium laureth-5 sulfates, coco MEA, cetyl alcohol, dimethicone

title: Vaseline Original Healing Jelly vs Equate Petroleum Jelly

brand.product: Vaseline Original Healing Jelly, 100% Pure Petroleum Jelly, 13 oz

alternative.product: Equate Petroleum Jelly Skin Protectant, 13 oz (Compare to Vaseline)

summary: Both are single-ingredient 100% white petrolatum USP skin protectants, so the product is literally the same substance.
evidence: Vaseline's Drug Facts list White Petrolatum USP (100%) as the only ingredient. Walmart lists Equate Petroleum Jelly's primary ingredient as 'White Petrolatum, USP (100%)', with 'Compare to Vaseline' in the product name.
differences: Vaseline claims a triple-purification process. Both are USP grade, so purity standards are the same, but refining and odour can vary slightly. The Equate price is the single-jar price shown on the 3-pack listing ($8.34 for 3).

aspects.brand: Vaseline Healing Jelly label lists water as the only inactive (2026 label)
aspects.alternative: Equate label lists no inactive ingredients

why: Both are 100% white petrolatum USP, the only ingredient on each label, so the USP grade is the same. Vaseline's extra is its triple-purification claim, and the record notes that refining and odour can vary slightly.

title: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream vs Equate Moisturizing Cream with Ceramides

brand.product: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream, Normal to Very Dry Skin, 16 oz

alternative.product: Equate Moisturizing Cream with Ceramides and Hyaluronic Acid, 16 oz

summary: Equate's ingredient list contains 22 of CeraVe's 24 ingredients in the same order, including the same three ceramides, cholesterol, phytosphingosine and hyaluronate. It is a near copy, not an exact one.
evidence: We compared the ordered ingredient lists published on Skinsort. CeraVe: Water, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetyl Alcohol, Ceteareth-20, Petrolatum, Potassium Phosphate, Ceramide NP, AP, EOP, Carbomer, Dimethicone, ... Ethylhexylglycerin. Equate has the identical sequence, except that it has no Cetyl Alcohol and lists Ceteareth-2 where CeraVe has Ceteareth-20 (possibly a transcription difference).
differences: This is NOT identical_formula: Equate lacks cetyl alcohol (and possibly differs in the ceteareth emulsifier), so texture and richness may differ slightly. CeraVe's MVE controlled-release technology claim is not stated for Equate. The ingredient lists come from a third-party database, not from the packaging.

aspects.brand: Ceramides NP, AP, EOP, phytosphingosine, cholesterol, hyaluronic acid (INCIDecoder, 2020 listing)
aspects.alternative: Same three ceramides, phytosphingosine, cholesterol, sodium hyaluronate (INCIDecoder, 2023 listing)

aspects.brand: 2020 CeraVe listing: phenoxyethanol, methylparaben, propylparaben (formula may have changed since)
aspects.alternative: Phenoxyethanol and ethylhexylglycerin (no parabens)

aspects.brand: Glycerin, cetearyl alcohol, petrolatum, dimethicone; fragrance-free
aspects.alternative: Glycerin, cetearyl alcohol, petrolatum, dimethicone; fragrance-free

why: Per the ordered ingredient lists on Skinsort, the Equate follows CeraVe's list almost item for item, with the same three ceramides, phytosphingosine, cholesterol and hyaluronate, and both are fragrance-free. It has no cetyl alcohol, and the lists come from a database rather than the packs, so this is a near copy, not an exact one.
